args.request: Reach a real car-selection screen by ordinary controller input headless; save new slots with extracted members and hashes; join on-screen labels to the numeric livery selector without claiming a full table.
args.diff:
+ connected hidden browser to noVNC, proved Space delivery (status 1->0)
+ loaded slot 98, unpaused to Living Legends theme screen
+ Cross on highlighted car opened the VEHICLE/TRACK/TYPE/STATUS detail panel
+ captured 3 labeled screens (cars 1, 5, 4) into slots 102, 103, 104 with unpacked members
+ L key moved highlight leftward (5->4 step; 1->5 wrap under hold), against assumed L=Right
+ EE: six static 12-name tables unchanged; triangulation found no isolated highlight word
+ slot 100 untouched; slot 101 backs up pre-experiment live state
